analysis:
Encore Capital soared 26.3%, 30.7 percentage points more than the market's 4.4% decline, following its Q3 earnings report yesterday. The coverage focuses on earnings results that beat estimates, with headlines highlighting record collections, 76% EPS growth, and a 66% earnings surprise according to GuruFocus and Zacks, though no article text is available beyond those headlines. The abnormal move beyond what the market's decline explains was 29.7%, substantially larger than this stock's typical earnings reaction of around 10.4 percentage points.

The earnings history shows the company has beaten estimates seven of the past eight quarters, but one of those beats was followed by a decline, and the single miss in early 2025 triggered a 21% drop. Beats have ranged from generating a 23% surge to a 2% decline, making the direction after a beat uncertain despite the strong surprise pattern. The company just reported, so the next quarterly results won't be due until early February 2027.
